scope: Four declined mechanics and one user-adopted replacement; no other boss behavior is removed.

policies.note: The user explicitly declined restoration of the reported low boss accuracy. No additional accuracy penalty is applied; existing behavior remains.
The user explicitly declined restoration of the reported low-HP player accuracy rule. No extra encounter accuracy hook is applied; existing behavior remains.
The user explicitly declined the unquantified critical-probability curve. The historical declaration is acknowledged without modifying critical probability; all weekday rules remain.
The user explicitly declined reconstruction of the temporary reflection window. Existing configured reflection remains; no activation/duration/termination window is added.

The user adopted current HP strictly below 25% as a dynamic forced-first direct-KO attack rule. At 25% or above ordinary behavior resumes, including after healing. This replaces conflicting historical thresholds and an unquantified damage curve; it is not official-server certification.
